title: Background Tasks: See, Schedule and Run Them | Orchard Core
description:
An Orchard Core site does work on its own: it clears caches, publishes scheduled content and removes old data. Without a page for that work, you cannot tell what ran, when it runs next, or whether a run failed.

The Background Tasks module lists every background task with its last run, its outcome and its next run. You change a task's schedule, enable or disable it, and run it on demand.

In this video:
• What background tasks are
• Enabling the Background Tasks module
• Reading the task list, with its layouts, search and filters
• Opening the details of a task
• Changing a task's schedule
• Running one task or several on demand
• Enabling and disabling tasks
• Failures, restarts and web farms
